name: How long does a garage-to-home office conversion typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage-to-home office conversion typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a garage-to-home office conversion varies based on the complexity of the design, necessary structural changes, and the extent of finish work. While a straightforward conversion might take several weeks, projects requiring new foundations, extensive plumbing, or re-routing existing utilities could take longer. AKN Design Group provides a transparent project timeline upfront, managing every phase from design approval and permit acquisition to construction and final walkthrough, ensuring clear communication throughout.
